name: Regression: Export modal multi-format navigation and deferred object URL teardown prevents download aborts
description: Verify opening the Export modal, switching between tabs (PNG, GIF, APNG, WebM, MP4, Sprite Sheet, Vector SVG, Shaders, .Pixibun), and verifying scale calculations without premature blob URL revocation.

planSteps.description: Click on the center drawing canvas to paint a pixel
Click the 'Export' button in the top header (with title 'Export PNG, GIF, or Spritesheet')
Verify the Export Studio Assets modal opens showing format tabs
Click the Vector SVG format tab
Verify SVG scale and smoothing options are displayed
Verify shader engine options appear for Godot and Unity
Verify the Project export options are displayed
Verify the export modal is dismissed and the studio workspace remains responsive
